name: Haus Sattelkopf
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

The Haus Sattelkopf is located in the St. Jakob district, above St. Anton am Arlberg, and offers a peaceful environment with a view of the surrounding mountains.

The rooms are modernly equipped and feature a balcony, WLAN, and satellite TV.

The hotel's own restaurant serves traditional Tiroler specialties as well as international dishes.

Thanks to its direct proximity to the ski lifts in winter and the hiking trails in summer, the house is an ideal starting point for activities.

The personal atmosphere and family-run management characterize the stay at Haus Sattelkopf.
